title: Strip embedded table linearizations from SRD prose fields (freeze-hardening)
description: Frozen SRD 5.1 pack must not contain garbled flattened table text in prose/description fields when the same table is represented by a table:* record. Capture each document table's exact source span (cell-tier run) at parse time and strip it from the owning record's prose. Examples: magic-item:necklace-of-prayer-beads ('20 Wind Wind walk walking'), magic-item:deck-of-many-things ('Playing Card Card...'), spell:teleport ('Off On Familiarity Mishap Area Target Target'), magic-item:armor-of-resistance ('Lightning 10 Thunder'). Authoritative table:* records must remain unchanged.
close_reason: Implemented in PR #230 (commit 67648aa): capture each embedded table's source span + reviewed owner, strip the linearization from owner prose in buildPack with a fail-closed completeness assertion. 39 owner records cleaned, table records unchanged, all gates green.
